question: Which Indian singer wrote ‘Raag Sarita’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chintaman Raghunath Vyas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Chintaman Raghunath Vyas** was a renowned classical vocalist of the Gwalior Gharana.
 
• He was born in 1924 and was popularly known as **C.R. Vyas**.
 
• He made significant contributions to Hindustani classical music and wrote several books, including **'Raag Sarita'**.
 
• C.R. Vyas was honored with prestigious awards like the **Padma Bhushan** for his contributions to Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gwalior Gharana**

 
 
• The Gwalior Gharana is one of the oldest and most prominent schools of Hindustani classical music.
 
• It was founded in the 19th century by Naththan Khan and Ustad Haddu Khan.
 
• The Gharana is known for its emphasis on precision in swara (notes) and laya (tempo).
 
• Many great maestros, including C.R. Vyas, have been associated with this Gharana.
 
 
 
• **Hindustani Classical Music**
 
 
• Hindustani classical music is the traditional music of northern regions of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It has a rich history and has evolved over centuries, incorporating various elements from different cultures and eras.
 
• The music is based on ragas (melodic frameworks) and talas (rhythmic cycles).
 
• It includes both vocal and instrumental traditions, with prominent instruments like the sitar, tabla, and harmonium.
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan**
 
 
• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in India, established in 1954.
 
• It is awarded to individuals for distinguished service of a high order in any field, including arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• Recipients of the award are announced annually on Republic Day (26th January).
 
• C.R. Vyas received this honor for his significant contributions to Indian classical music.
